categories.main_business_segments: Sailun Group primarily operates in the tire manufacturing industry, producing semi-steel radial tires, all-steel radial tires, and off-the-road tires. Their products serve passenger cars, commercial vehicles, special vehicles, engineering machinery, and agricultural equipment. The company also engages in tire recycling and tire trading through overseas subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies including semi-steel and all-steel radial tire manufacturing and off-the-road tire production. They have developed the 'Liquid Gold Tire' technology that optimizes rolling resistance, wet grip, and wear resistance simultaneously. Production methods incorporate digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and an industrial internet platform called 'Rubber Chain Cloud' to enable flexible, automated, and quality-controlled manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sailun serves automotive manufacturers such as BYD, Chery, Geely, NIO, FAW Jiefang, Dongfeng, and others, as well as commercial vehicle and engineering machinery manufacturers like Caterpillar, John Deere, and Sany. Their tires are sold globally to end-users in replacement markets and original equipment markets across passenger cars, trucks, buses, agricultural and construction machinery sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases in China (Qingdao, Dongying, Shenyang, Weifang), Vietnam, Cambodia, and is expanding in Mexico, Indonesia, and other countries. Their sales network covers over 180 countries and regions including North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and South America, with localized sales teams in key markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sailun operates primarily in the midstream segment of the tire supply chain, focusing on tire manufacturing and assembly. They also engage in downstream activities including tire sales and distribution through subsidiaries and dealers. Upstream, they manage procurement of raw materials like natural rubber, synthetic rubber, carbon black, and steel cord.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in core tire technologies, digital transformation, and sustainable development. R&D focuses on high-performance, intelligent, and green tires, including expanding the 'Liquid Gold Tire' technology. They invest in industrial internet platforms, smart factories, and global R&D centers to enhance product development and manufacturing efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Sailun generates revenue mainly through product sales of tires to OEMs, commercial fleets, and replacement markets. They also earn income from tire recycling products and overseas tire trading operations. Revenue is derived from direct sales, distribution through dealers, and some direct-to-customer channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sailun is positioned as a leading Chinese tire manufacturer ranked 10th globally by industry publications. They compete with international giants like Michelin, Bridgestone, and Goodyear, leveraging technology innovation, cost advantages, and global production footprint to increase market share, especially in emerging markets and the growing new energy vehicle segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sailun achieved revenue of approximately RMB 31.8 billion, a 22.4% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.06 billion, up 31.4%. Total assets reached RMB 40.3 billion, growing 19.5%. The company has shown consistent growth in production volume, sales, and profitability, supported by expanding global operations and R&D investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sailun emphasizes delivering high-quality, technologically advanced tires with superior performance in rolling resistance, wet grip, and durability, exemplified by their proprietary 'Liquid Gold Tire' technology. Their global manufacturing and supply chain integration enable agile delivery and cost efficiency. The company also focuses on sustainability, producing green tires with high sustainable material content and low carbon footprint, appealing to environmentally conscious customers.
